newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Persson says goal to halve jobless rate realistic.
newsitem.headline: Persson says goal to halve jobless rate realistic.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson said on Wednesday the government's goal to halve unemployment by the year 2000 was realistic in light of an upturn in the economy.
"If the economy improves more than we thought then it is realistic to reach this goal," Persson told reporters at a seminar, rejecting arguments he was over-optimistic.
Persson said the government's forecasts for the economy were cautious.
"The upturn in the economy is perhaps more significant than what we had forecast. We estimated moderate economic development but now it seems like it is more than moderate," Persson said.
